title: Chintamani Library v2.7.0 — 4D Multicolor UI Overhaul, Real-Time Animated Login & Enhanced Student Hub
releaseNotes: REORGANIZED MEMBERS DIRECTORY: Premium 4D tactile cards with idle 3D perspective tilt, pulsing avatar aura, and smooth pull-to-refresh
NEW 4D MULTICOLOR ACTION CHIPS: All 15 member action buttons redesigned with 4D gradient depth, top specular sheen, and instant haptic feedback
WHATSAPP HUB 4D OVERHAUL: Multicolor jewel tabs (Auto Bot, Broadcast, Students) with illuminated active indicators
STUDENTS DIRECTORY CARDS: Personalized jewel-toned cards per student with branch seat badges and 1-tap WhatsApp chat pill
4D AUDIENCE FILTER SELECTOR: Structured multi-category selector with vertical accent glow and 3D icon tiles
REAL-TIME ANIMATED LOGIN SCREEN: Floating particle field, pulsating golden seal, shimmer sweep button, and staggered entrance
MORE SCREEN 4D ICONS: High-fidelity 4D isometric graphics across Universal QR, Lockers, Admissions, and System settings
SEAMLESS IN-APP OTA DELIVERY: Instant background detection and native 1-tap in-app package upgrade
